# Dragoon's Town 0.18 — A natural waterfront town

Completely replaces the pixel-art draft with a clean, detailed, near-realistic coastal town. Curving streets, a river bridge, a central fountain, landscaped terraces, hills and a yacht marina form one connected scene. Ten real business hitboxes are mapped to the corresponding buildings; unowned businesses have weathered, boarded storefront overlays and visible prices. Buying restores their appearance. The selected business has an outline and a detail panel.

Clean balance, quantity and navigation controls replace the pixel UI. Landscape uses the wide town view with controls on the right; portrait fits the entire town into a scenic backdrop. No scrolling is required to see all businesses. The artwork keeps its original proportions in both orientations.

Existing saves, personalized town names, goals, progression and economy are preserved. Art is bundled inside Android for offline play. Physical testing on the Thor remains necessary.

Original town artwork generated with OpenAI image generation; integration and testing assisted by OpenAI Codex. No real purchases or ads are enabled.

AI-assisted development with OpenAI Codex.
